title: Repair Set-Aside Rider: Sizing, Fee, Draw and Completion Terms
content:
The Repair Set-Aside is the plan of Set-Aside Accounts that pays contractors for repairs the appraisal required at closing. Its terms are set out below together with the corresponding settings of the other plans, which make no repair payments.

| Term | Repair Set-Aside | Every other plan (Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory), Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected), Partially Funded LESA, Servicing Fee Set-Aside, Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve) |
|---|---|---|
| Pays contractors for required repairs | Yes | No |
| Repair set-aside as a percent of the accepted repair estimate | 150.0% | 0.0 |
| Largest repair set-aside, as a percent of the loan's maximum claim amount | 15.0% | 0.0 |
| Calendar months after establishment within which repairs must be completed and disbursed | 12 | 0 |
| Repair administration fee, percent of the repair set-aside, charged at closing | 1.5% | 0.0 |
| Minimum repair administration fee | 50.00 USD | 0.00 |
| Largest number of progress disbursements before the final disbursement | 2 | 0 |
| Minimum percent of the work an inspection must find complete before a progress disbursement | 50.0% | 0.0 |
| Percent of each progress disbursement held back until the final inspection | 10.0% | 0.0 |
| Every repair disbursement needs an inspection report on file | Yes | No |
| Destination of the unused repair balance once repairs are certified complete | The HECM available line of credit | Not applicable |

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

- **Sizing.** An accepted repair estimate of 8,000.00 gives a repair set-aside of 150.0 percent of it, 12,000.00, which must also be no more than 15.0 percent of the loan's maximum claim amount.
- **Administration fee.** On that 12,000.00 set-aside, 1.5 percent is 180.00, which is above the 50.00 minimum, so the fee is 180.00. On a 2,000.00 set-aside, 1.5 percent is 30.00, below the minimum, so the fee is 50.00.
- **Progress holdback.** A progress invoice of 4,000.00 has 10.0 percent, 400.00, held back until the final inspection.
